Grounded explain receipt
Import rule-environment receipt: target ruleset sr5; import remains review-only until the grounded receipt is emitted.
Import environment diff: before review-only/sr5; after oracle-reviewed/sr5; review stays copy-safe until the user accepts import.
Import receipt correlation key: import/sr5/review-only; matches the blocker, oracle, and before/after environment diff lines below.
Receipt scope: import target sr5; before/after diff is copy-safe and excludes raw character XML until the user accepts import.
Import support handoff receipt: support can cite import/sr5/review-only with oracle, source-toggle, and blocker text; raw XML stays excluded unless the user attaches it.
Grounded import explain receipt: target sr5; oracle oracle coverage is reviewed before the workspace is changed; source toggles source toggles stay unchanged until import acceptance; blocker no grounded import blocker is present before acceptance.
Import staged artifact receipt: staged file selected import file; raw XML review has 51 character(s).
Import diagnostics receipt: before review-only/sr5; after oracle-reviewed/sr5; blocker no grounded import blocker is present before acceptance; proof oracle coverage is reviewed before the workspace is changed.
Import diagnostics diff: before review-only sr5 with source toggles stay unchanged until import acceptance; after oracle-reviewed sr5 with blocker no grounded import blocker is present before acceptance; no workspace, source-toggle, or support state changes before acceptance.
Import support diagnostics receipt: support can cite import/sr5/review-only with before/after source-toggle truth, blocker text, and oracle proof without changing local workspace state.
Before import environment diff
Import source-toggle diff receipt: before import source toggles stay unchanged until import acceptance; after acceptance only reviewed sr5 source toggles bind to the workspace.
Import artifact diff receipt: before staged artifact staged file selected import file; raw XML review has 51 character(s); after acceptance raw payload stays excluded from the support receipt unless the user attaches it.
Import environment tuple diff: before workspace/current-source/support-local/review-only; after oracle-reviewed/sr5/accepted-source-only; correlation import/sr5/review-only.
Environment diff before import: the current workspace and support posture stay unchanged. Source toggles, support posture, and saved character remain unchanged; source toggles stay unchanged until import acceptance.
After review environment diff
Environment diff after import: imported content is expected to bind to sr5; accepted content binds to sr5 only after oracle review; oracle coverage is reviewed before the workspace is changed.
Import blocker receipt: no grounded import blocker is present before acceptance.
Import blocker diff receipt: before blocker no grounded import blocker is present before acceptance; after acceptance keeps the blocker visible until oracle review clears it.
Raw import receipt: raw XML review has 51 character(s).

visibleNamedControls.Name: DialogTrustReceiptText
visibleNamedControls.Text:
Grounded explain receipt
Import rule-environment receipt: target ruleset sr5; import remains review-only until the grounded receipt is emitted.
Import environment diff: before review-only/sr5; after oracle-reviewed/sr5; review stays copy-safe until the user accepts import.
Import receipt correlation key: import/sr5/review-only; matches the blocker, oracle, and before/after environment diff lines below.
Receipt scope: import target sr5; before/after diff is copy-safe and excludes raw character XML until the user accepts import.
Import support handoff receipt: support can cite import/sr5/review-only with oracle, source-toggle, and blocker text; raw XML stays excluded unless the user attaches it.
Grounded import explain receipt: target sr5; oracle oracle coverage is reviewed before the workspace is changed; source toggles source toggles stay unchanged until import acceptance; blocker no grounded import blocker is present before acceptance.
Import staged artifact receipt: staged file selected import file; raw XML review has 51 character(s).
Import diagnostics receipt: before review-only/sr5; after oracle-reviewed/sr5; blocker no grounded import blocker is present before acceptance; proof oracle coverage is reviewed before the workspace is changed.
Import diagnostics diff: before review-only sr5 with source toggles stay unchanged until import acceptance; after oracle-reviewed sr5 with blocker no grounded import blocker is present before acceptance; no workspace, source-toggle, or support state changes before acceptance.
Import support diagnostics receipt: support can cite import/sr5/review-only with before/after source-toggle truth, blocker text, and oracle proof without changing local workspace state.
Before import environment diff
Import source-toggle diff receipt: before import source toggles stay unchanged until import acceptance; after acceptance only reviewed sr5 source toggles bind to the workspace.
Import artifact diff receipt: before staged artifact staged file selected import file; raw XML review has 51 character(s); after acceptance raw payload stays excluded from the support receipt unless the user attaches it.
Import environment tuple diff: before workspace/current-source/support-local/review-only; after oracle-reviewed/sr5/accepted-source-only; correlation import/sr5/review-only.
Environment diff before import: the current workspace and support posture stay unchanged. Source toggles, support posture, and saved character remain unchanged; source toggles stay unchanged until import acceptance.
After review environment diff
Environment diff after import: imported content is expected to bind to sr5; accepted content binds to sr5 only after oracle review; oracle coverage is reviewed before the workspace is changed.
Import blocker receipt: no grounded import blocker is present before acceptance.
Import blocker diff receipt: before blocker no grounded import blocker is present before acceptance; after acceptance keeps the blocker visible until oracle review clears it.
Hero Lab import receipt: raw XML review has 51 character(s).
